methodology: HTTP method/path operations are extracted from game.go and playfabapi.go with their enclosing title conditions; additional static, management and computed CDN routes are resolved explicitly.
Routing fallthroughs, TODO comments, implicit HTTP HEAD support and unspecified proxy paths are not counted.
Game IDs describe emulator registration conditions, not independently confirmed publisher support; an absent emulator route does not prove publisher absence.

Source type fields preserve Go json/schema tags. Embedded structs and custom codecs are not expanded; field lists are not complete wire schemas. Names ending in Request do not necessarily describe inbound payloads.
Resources are inventoried by path/hash/shape; their full contents are not copied and are not guaranteed current.
All operations are source-only. Local management/file routes are explicitly marked. Existing service observations remain unchanged.
